events.title: FDA renews Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee for two additional years
events.summary: The Food and Drug Administration announced renewal of the Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee for an additional two years, extending its charter until June 4, 2028. The Commissioner determined renewal is in the public interest based on the committee's essential role in providing independent expert advice on psychiatric drug products, the continued need for specialized expertise in this therapeutic area, and demonstrated value supporting FDA's regulatory mission. The committee will maintain its core of at least six voting members selected from authorities in psychopharmacology, psychiatry, epidemiology, and related specialties, with an annual budget of $89,984.
events.why_relevant: Renewal of a federal advisory committee affects the composition and continuity of expert input into FDA regulatory decisions on psychiatric medications, which directly impact public health policy and drug approval processes.
events.basis: The Commissioner has determined that it is in the public interest to renew the Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee for an additional 2 years beyond the charter expiration date.
